mechanism: AWS supplies compute, model services and infrastructure to AI workloads; durable utilization and pricing can expand Amazon operating earnings, advertising and retail productivity when incremental returns exceed depreciation, financing, energy and dilution costs.
catalyst: AWS growth and margins remain strong, AI services broaden consumption, infrastructure utilization rises, retail and advertising productivity improve, and free cash flow turns positive without impairing the growth runway.
invalidation: AI infrastructure utilization, AWS growth or margins fail to compensate for capital intensity, depreciation, financing and dilution; customer concentration or competition erodes returns; or operating cash conversion remains structurally negative.
